title: Daddy's Sausage and Peppers
description: Italian sausage and bell peppers are cooked with tomatoes and cheese in this delicious dish that turns a bowl of plain pasta into a rave-worthy meal!
ingredients: 3 green bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips
2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips
1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips

steps.text: Slice each sausage link into 5 pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook until browned, turning as needed. Drain excess grease.
Add bell peppers, tomatoes, and Italian seasoning, then drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.

Stir in onion and garlic, then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and simmer for 15 more minutes. Stir, then top with mozzarella cheese. Cover and cook for 5 minutes to melt the cheese. Remove from the heat and enjoy.
